name: Killer Eyelashes
source:
How likely was it that your debut as a drag artist would be overshadowed by a zombie apocalypse? No one expected it, but overnight the world is full of paint-splattered zombies invading the streets in search of new victims to make up and convert. For some reason, drags with their excess of infected make-up have acquired superpowers and are now humanity's only salvation.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3402320/Killer_Eyelashes/?curator_clanid=4777282]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你作为变装艺术家的首次亮相有多大可能会被僵尸末日蒙上阴影？没有人预料到，一夜之间，世界上就充满了泼满油漆的僵尸，它们入侵街道，寻找新的受害者来弥补和皈依。出于某种原因，带有过多受感染化妆品的变装者获得了超能力，现在是人类唯一的救赎。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3402320/Killer_Eyelashes/?curator_clanid=4777282]Steam[/url]]
